FX-GOVER-001.says: Gradient Overlay as added: Normal, 100, white at 0 to black at 100, angle 90, linear, scale 100. The plate turns from black along its top row to white along its bottom row (location 0 is where the angle points away from); its alpha never changes, so the empty corners stay empty.

FX-GOVER-002.says: Angle 0, red at 0 to blue at 100: red down the plate's left edge, blue down its right, the same in every row.

FX-GOVER-003.says: The tutorial's (PVUPTcfJ5HY 4:00-6:40, pv_400): Overlay, 100, #232444 at both colour stops, opacity 0 at 65.6 and 100 at 100, angle 90, Radial, scale 150. Only the plate's two left-hand corners, the pixels farthest from the box's centre, darken, like a vignette's edge; the rest is untouched.

FX-GOVER-004.says: Reflected, angle 0, red at 0 to blue at 100: red down the middle, blue at both side edges, left and right the same.

FX-GOVER-005.says: Angle style at 0, red to blue: the colour goes round the box's centre counter-clockwise from the right, red just above the right-hand middle, blue just below it.

FX-GOVER-006.says: Diamond, angle 0, red to blue: red in the middle, a diamond of blue growing out to the plate's corners.

FX-GOVER-007.says: FX-GOVER-001 with Reverse on: white along the top, black along the bottom.

FX-GOVER-008.says: Radial, red to blue, offset 3 pixels right: the red middle moves three columns right of the box's centre.

FX-GOVER-009.says: Angle keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 180 at frame 4, linear, red to blue: at frame 0 red on the left, at frame 2 (90) red on the bottom, at frame 4 red on the right.

FX-GOVER-010.says: Three colour stops, red at 0, #ff8000 at 50 and blue at 100, angle 0, scale 50: red over the left quarter, through orange at the middle, blue past the right quarter.

FX-GOVER-012.says: Multiply, #ff8000 to blue, angle 0: the skin multiplied by orange on the left, by blue on the right.

FX-GOVER-013.says: An Inner Shadow listed first (Normal, #ff8000, 100, Global Light off, angle 0, distance 2, size 0), then the Gradient Overlay as added: the overlay is drawn first, so the plate's two right-hand columns are orange over the black-to-white ramp.

FX-GOVER-014.says: Opacity stops 100 at 0 and 0 at 100, angle 0, red to red: solid red on the left fading to the plate's own skin on the right.

FX-GOVER-015.says: Two stops at the same place, red at 0 and 50, blue at 50 and 100, angle 0: a hard step from red to blue down the middle, no blend between.
